QuestInfo.name: Alex's Gold Watch
QuestInfo.0: Jay has a favor to ask of you. Speak to Jay.
QuestInfo.1: Jay says Alex is desperately looking for a Gold Watch that belonged to Alex's deceased mother. Chief Stan had it, but he lost it when he got attacked by the Mushmom in the forest. Defeat Mushmom, retrieve Alex's Gold Watch, and send it to Alex in Kerning City. Use the mailbox located in front of the house to send it.
QuestInfo.2: At Jay's request, you defeated Mushmom, retrieved the Gold Watch, and sent the watch to Alex.

0.0: Alex wrote back to me. He's doing okay, but he said he's not coming back yet. He wants me to send him his mother's keepsake Gold Watch, but... Stan had it, and lost it in the forest when he got jumped by the Mushmom. I have no idea why he took her watch out there, but do you think you could get it back?\r\n

yes.0: The Mushmom probably took the Gold Watch. It likes shiny stuff...I heard it has a whole nest of loose change and tin foil. You'll find Mushmom on the Mushmom Forest Trail, right from the Humming Forest Trail. Get the Gold Watch back, and then drop it in the Mailbox in front of my house. The mailman will come and pick it up tomorrow.

no.0: Oh, man... Alex really wants that watch. Should I try to get it myself...? I better start training, I guess.

1.0: #b(You see an envelope with a Kerning City address on it. You put the watch in the envelope.)#k\r\n

yes.0: #b(You closed the Mailbox. Doesn't seem like Mrs. Ming Ming saw you.)#k
